dialogue: Could you plan Sioux Falls to two cities in Arizona, March 16-20, 2022? I have $2,500. The budget is soft
One-way, ending in Flagstaff on the 20th. Fly into Phoenix by 9pm on the 16th, then Flagstaff by noon on the 18th. Private rooms rated 3+, just two nights in each city.
Two adult friends are coming too. Same flights and one place big enough for all three in each city. We have $5,000 total.

Let's prioritize the Heard Museum and Desert Botanical Garden and drop Hole in the Rock so there's enough time for transit and sit-down meals. Keep March 16 mainly for arrival and protect the March 18 transfer to Flagstaff. A relaxed pace at preferred attractions matters more than squeezing in extra stops; the one-way visit still ends in Flagstaff on March 20.

A relaxed pace matters more than fitting in every Flagstaff stop: on March 19, drop Riordan Mansion and take direct taxis or rideshares between the lodging, Museum of Northern Arizona, and Lowell Observatory to preserve meal breaks. Keep only the Heard Museum and Desert Botanical Garden in Phoenix on March 17.
Please include at least one Chinese meal in both Phoenix and Flagstaff while keeping each meal under $50.

agent_action.rationale: F4045477 arrives before 21:00, and F3804854 reaches Flagstaff before noon. The plan preserves two nights in each city, the requested attractions, direct March 19 taxis/rideshares, meal breaks, and Chinese meals with every listed per-traveler average below $50. Known costs are $1,356 for flights, $2,590 for four lodging nights, and approximately $765 for meals for three travelers, totaling $4,711. Taxi/rideshare fares, attraction admission, and packed-food costs are unpriced, so a final total under the soft $5,000 budget cannot be verified. No supported private-room listing in either city accommodates all three people; the selected entire-home listings sacrifice the private-room requirement while preserving one lodging, adequate occupancy, ratings of at least 3, and exactly two nights per city.
